Lin Xia looks up from the notes and asks with cautious hope, <d>[Chinese] 坐标你记得吗？</d> Her expression suggests that she expects this part to be straightforward. She replies without hesitation, <d>[Chinese] 当然。</d> She sets her staff against the edge of the table, bends down, and drags a thick old magic book toward herself. Because the book is large relative to her body, the movement has a slight physical struggle but remains believable rather than slapstick. She rapidly turns several heavy pages until she reaches the final page. Lin Xia leans closer with renewed expectation. Zhuzi also shifts forward, curious about what a magical-world coordinate system will look like.

[Shot 3] At 00:13.000, the camera makes a real cut to an isolated close continuity-guide shot that lasts exactly until 00:15.000. The open spellbook dominates the lower center of frame while the three characters are arranged around it. The final page clearly displays the handwritten Chinese text: “银月森林往东二百步。” <Subject 3> proudly points to the sentence with the end of her tiny finger, completely convinced that the coordinates are precise. <Subject 1> freezes for a moment and her previously hopeful expression slowly changes into visible confusion. <Subject 2> leans closer, silently reads the sentence, then slowly raises his eyes from the page with a blank, speechless, deeply unconvinced expression.
